report.title: IRDAI Information & Cyber Security - Database Controls Report
report.author: DBDOME Security Team (dbexpert.ai)

sections.text: IRDAI Cyber Security - Database Activity Monitoring Report

sections.content: Compliance evidence aligned to IRDAI's Information and Cyber Security Guidelines for insurers, generated automatically by the DBDOME platform. Focus areas: least-privilege enforcement, protection of policyholder personal data, access monitoring, control over critical/destructive operations, and audit-trail integrity.

sections.query: SELECT rule_name, action_type, attempted_by, resource_id, resource_owner, violation_reason, detected_at FROM log.sod_violations WHERE detected_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT gm.server, gm.metric_name AS root_cause_id, COALESCE(rc.name, gm.metric_name) AS control, (gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'row_count')::int AS accounts, COALESCE(gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity','high') AS severity, gm.entry_date AS detected_at FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm LEFT JOIN rootcause.root_causes rc ON rc.root_cause_id = gm.metric_name WHERE (gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-AUD-026%%' OR gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-AZ%%' OR gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-AUTHZ%%') AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY gm.entry_date DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT gm.server, gm.metric_name AS root_cause_id, COALESCE(rc.name, gm.metric_name) AS control, (gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'row_count')::int AS items_found, COALESCE(gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity','medium') AS severity, gm.entry_date AS detected_at FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm LEFT JOIN rootcause.root_causes rc ON rc.root_cause_id = gm.metric_name WHERE gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-PRI%%' AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY gm.entry_date DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', gm.entry_date) AS day, COUNT(*) AS pii_access_events FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm WHERE gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010-RC05%%' AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
sections.title: Sensitive-Data Access Events (30-Day Trend)
sections.caption: Detections of access to sensitive/personal data over the last 30 days

sections.query: SELECT gm.server, COUNT(*) AS auth_findings FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm WHERE (gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-AU%%' OR gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010-RC01%%' OR gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010-RC07%%') AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY gm.server ORDER BY auth_findings DESC LIMIT 10
sections.title: Authentication / Access Findings by Database (7 days)
sections.caption: Failed-login, unknown-login and off-hours access findings by database

sections.query: SELECT gm.server, gm.metric_name AS root_cause_id, (gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'row_count')::int AS events, COALESCE(gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity','high') AS severity, gm.entry_date AS detected_at FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm WHERE (gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-AUD-027%%' OR gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010-RC13%%' OR gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010-RC09%%') AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY gm.entry_date DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT period_name, regulation, total_controls, attested, exceptions, pending, completion_pct, due_date FROM log.v_attestation_summary WHERE regulation ILIKE '%%IRDAI%%' ORDER BY due_date DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
SELECT table_name, rows_hashed, verified_at, CASE WHEN is_valid THEN 'INTACT' ELSE 'BROKEN' END AS chain_status FROM log.hash_chain_checkpoints ORDER BY verified_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20
